text: The Quarkus replatform target repo is mariakalykaki/Replatforming-System-Demoo (package com.example.service, writable); MNP_Demo_Slim is the read-only legacy .NET reference.

GitHub writes (issue create etc.) are refused unless the agent owner has a personal GitHub token (repo+workflow scope) configured on the SSH Keys / GitHub Tokens page; there is no fallback to a shared credential.
